DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy with associated radiculopathy.

The imaging confirms compression of the cervical spinal cord explaining your progressive weakness, balance issues, and the "burning" pain that has now spread. Given the severity of the myelopathy, surgical decompression is urgently indicated to prevent permanent neurological damage.
